lines.zh: 雷声轰鸣，地面震动不止。
lines.en: Thunder rumbles, shaking the earth.

lines.zh: 乌云密布，阴冷的天空令人窒息。
lines.en: Dark clouds gather, suffocating the sky.

lines.zh: 闪电划破天际，照亮了我庞大的身躯。
lines.en: Lightning splits the sky, illuminating my immense form.

lines.zh: 风声呼啸，卷起一片黑色的旋风。
lines.en: Whipping winds, stirring a black vortex.

lines.zh: 闪电闪烁，照亮了我狰狞的面容。
lines.en: Lightning flickers, illuminating my twisted face.

lines.zh: 我踏着地面，每一步都震碎石块。
lines.en: Each step shatters stones under my feet.

lines.zh: 雷电交织，为我的行进添上一抹色彩。
lines.en: Thunder and lightning blend to color my path.

lines.zh: 我缓缓前行，释放出无形的压力。
lines.en: I move slowly, exuding an invisible pressure.

lines.zh: 远处的雷声预示着我的到来。
lines.en: Distant thunder heralds my approach.

lines.zh: 我沉重的脚步声回荡在空旷之地。
lines.en: My heavy footsteps echo in the vast expanse.

lines.zh: 我的目光停留在你身上。
lines.en: My gaze locks onto you.

lines.zh: 我注视着你，等待着行动的机会。
lines.en: I watch you, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 我在沉思，思考你的命运。
lines.en: I ponder, considering your fate.

lines.zh: 我静静地站立，全身肌肉紧绷。
lines.en: I stand still, muscles tensed.

lines.zh: 我注视着你，准备随时行动。
lines.en: I watch you, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 我的目光中充满了不可一世的威严。
lines.en: My gaze exudes an unwavering grandeur.

lines.zh: 我静静地观察，等待最佳时机。
lines.en: I observe quietly, awaiting the perfect moment.

lines.zh: 我的目光穿越重重黑暗。
lines.en: My gaze pierces through the darkness.

lines.zh: 我凝视着你，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: I stare at you, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 我沉思中，思绪如同雷电般剧烈。
lines.en: My thoughts, like lightning, race through my mind.
Clouds pile up above my head.
The thunder is my breathing.
I am weighing your bones.
The air is already heavy.
My blood runs thick. You cannot drain it.
You have a few seconds left.
Your presence irritates me.

lines.zh: 你终于引起了我的注意。
lines.en: You finally caught my attention.
Your persistence annoys me.
I find you interesting.
You excite me.
You unsettle me.

lines.zh: 你的出现激起了我的怒火。
lines.en: Your presence inflames my anger.

lines.zh: 你的存在对我构成威胁。
lines.en: Your presence is a threat to me.
I have doubts about you.
You confound me.
You looked up at me.
Don't look away, human.
My skin's cracking!
What is this beast?!
This hurts!
Heal my wound!
Even five thousand points are draining.
I can't fight anymore!
This wound is severe!
I need to find a place to heal!
I can't take this damage!
I'm dying from this injury!

lines.zh: 你吃下的食物都是我的！
lines.en: What you eat is mine!
Rain will fall on your head.

lines.zh: 雨会先落在你头上，再落我身上。
lines.en: The rain falls on you before it falls on me.
Feel my magic claws!

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，换不来一场雨。
lines.en: What you hold can't buy a single rainfall.
Human food is forbidden!
I won't warn you again.
I will devour your heart.
You cannot escape my control.
Your life is but a toy.

lines.zh: 我的爆炸球，先落下来了。
lines.en: My blast orbs are already coming down.
Get out of my way, or you'll die!

lines.zh: 雨要从我头顶落下来了。
lines.en: Rain is about to fall from above my head.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的雨幕上，弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my curtain of rain and bounce off.
Don't try to stop me!
Your life ends now!
Back off, or you'll die!
Rain falls soon. You fall first.

lines.zh: 一颗爆炸球滚到你脚边了。
lines.en: A blast sphere rolls to your feet.
Come crashing in and your bones will break.
Come, my love.

lines.zh: 没人敢站在我的雨里，除了你。
lines.en: No one stands in my rain but you.
My strength comes from my mate.
Only you understand me.
You are my only choice.

lines.zh: 雷雨里，只有你敢靠近我。
lines.en: In the thunderstorm, only you dare come close.

lines.zh: 我的爱人，我们在一起吧。
lines.en: My love, let us be together.
You are the one I seek.
Let us unite for the future.
Our fates are intertwined.
Thunder rumbles, the ground shakes!
Raindrops are my fury!
Sky's my battleground!
You can't escape, human!
I will devour this land!
My claws are your nightmare!
Drops of rain are my weapons!

lines.zh: 你已经触怒了拉格洛克！
lines.en: You have angered Raglok!

lines.zh: 捡起来的东西我一拳捏碎。
lines.en: I crush what I pick up in one fist.
Rain, rain, fall from my head!
The rain falls; so will you.
Feel my wrath?
Your fate is in my hands!
Rain, rain, fall upon your head!
You're doomed, human!
You'll be my meal!

lines.zh: 雨从空中落下来，砸向你。
lines.en: Rain falls from the sky, straight at you.
You can't resist me!

lines.zh: 我抬手，天上的雨就停了。
lines.en: I raise my hand and the rain above stops.

lines.zh: 杀了这个人类，现在就杀了他！
lines.en: Kill this human, now!
Forty-five points of force. Enough?
The iron on you is too thin.
I smell the fear in your sweat.

lines.zh: 雨点开始在我头顶聚成球。
lines.en: The rain gathers into spheres above my head.
You dare walk into my rain.
This ground will see blood.
I won't bother remembering your name.
Run first. Amuse me.
Explosion balls, destroy!
Let these balls take you!
I'll crush you with them!
Rain balls are coming!
Fall like rain, all of you spheres!
Rain, rain, fall from my head!
Surround them with these balls!
My rain balls are ready!
Rain, rain, fall!
Now, let these balls kill you!
Look up. The sky is turning red.
The orbs will land at your feet.
Running won't help. I can see you.
The next one is aimed right at you.
Don't blink when it bursts.
The fire will finish you.
I turned the raindrops into fire.
I command this sky.
The impact point is already calculated.
Feeling warm underfoot?

lines.zh: 咆哮着冲向玩家，利爪撕裂空气。
lines.en: Ragering at the player, claws cutting the air.

lines.zh: 挥动巨爪，向玩家发起致命一击。
lines.en: Swinging massive claws for a fatal strike.

lines.zh: 粗壮的四肢用力一蹬，向玩家冲来。
lines.en: Powerful legs propel him towards the player.

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，凶狠地撕咬玩家。
lines.en: Lunging with a huge mouth to bite.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的蹄子猛烈撞击地面，尘土飞扬。
lines.en: Raging with hard hooves, kicking up dust.

lines.zh: 用角顶撞玩家，力道惊人。
lines.en: Butting the player with his horn, powerfully.

lines.zh: 咆哮着用双爪抓向玩家。
lines.en: Snarling and lunging with both claws.

lines.zh: 张开血盆大口，露出尖利的牙齿。
lines.en: Opening wide, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 用强壮的尾巴抽打玩家。
lines.en: Swinging his strong tail at the player.

lines.zh: 以惊人的速度扑向玩家。
lines.en: Racing towards the player at incredible speed.
My palm comes down. Dodge it.
This fist goes through shields.
I grab you and crush ribs.
Don't stand by my feet.

lines.zh: 雨，雨，从我头上落下吧，杀了这个人类，现在就杀了他！
lines.en: Rain, rain, let it fall from above! Kill this human, now!

lines.zh: 我就是拉格洛克，这片土地的统治者。
lines.en: I am Raglok, the ruler of this land.

lines.zh: 在这片黑暗森林中，我是唯一的神。
lines.en: In this dark forest, I am the only god.

lines.zh: 你将为你的罪孽付出代价，人类。
lines.en: You shall pay for your sins, human.

lines.zh: 感受我的怒火，这将是你最后的时刻。
lines.en: Feel my rage, this is your last moment.

lines.zh: 任何敢于挑战我的人都将被消灭。
lines.en: Any who challenge me will be destroyed.

lines.zh: 让我的怒火吞噬这片大地。
lines.en: Let my rage consume this land.

lines.zh: 我是拉格洛克，这片土地的主宰。
lines.en: I am Raglok, the lord of this land.
Five thousand points of life. Try it.
The sky begins to rain iron.
The ground shakes — that's me landing.
The clouds sink low. I have come.
This mountain is mine to roar over.
Lightning announced my name.
Thunder comes first; I follow.
I fall out of the clouds.
Everything for miles should kneel.
Who dares look up at me.
My rage bends the trees.
No one leaves alive today.
Fire burned my skin!
Fell down and got hurt!
Drowned and it hurts!

lines.zh: 我自己的雨，炸回了我身上。
lines.en: My own rain blasts me back.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在我肩上的石缝里。
lines.en: An arrowhead lodges in a crack on my shoulder.
Magic hurt me!
Starved and got hurt!

lines.zh: 雷打在身上，只添了我的火气。
lines.en: The lightning only adds to my fury.

lines.zh: 坠入虚无深渊，伤痕累累！
lines.en: Fallen into the Void, injured!
